title: Ladji Diaby at Lafayette Anticipations, Paris
description: For his exhibition Who's Gonna Save the World? at Lafayette Anticipations, Ladji Diaby presents an installation built from furniture found on the street or sourced second-hand. Each piece has been transformed by the artist, echoing his mother's habit of decorating and embellishing furniture ...
